verses.text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

segments.text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

segments.text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

segments.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

segments.text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

segments.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

segments.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove!
would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.text: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

segments.text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm

verses.text: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

segments.text: divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

segments.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow

verses.text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

segments.text: in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

segments.text: reproached me; then I could have borne
against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

segments.text: thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

notes: 55.13 mine equal: Heb. according to my rank

verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

segments.text: walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.text: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

segments.text: let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness

verses.text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

segments.text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

verses.text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

segments.text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.text: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

segments.text: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle
against me: for there were many with me.

verses.text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

segments.text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

notes: 55.19 Because…: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they

verses.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

segments.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.text: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

segments.text: of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war
in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet

verses.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

segments.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

segments.text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

notes: 55.23 bloody…: Heb. men of bloods and deceit
55.23 shall…: Heb. shall not half their days

headings.text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David.
